 Hyderabad Top News Gold rate today in Hyderabad, October 24, 2026: Check 22K, 24K and 18K gold prices
 Subhransu Satpathy 24 Oct 2026 9:53 AM Share this: HYDERABAD: Gold prices in Hyderabad edged lower on Saturday, October 24, 2026, according to the latest updated rates. The 22-carat gold rate fell by ₹10 per 10 grams to ₹1,30,590, while 24-carat gold slipped to ₹1,42,470. Similarly, the 18-carat gold rate dropped to ₹1,06,850 per 10 grams.
 On a per-gram basis, all three gold categories declined by ₹1. Silver prices also fell by 10 paise per gram to ₹224.90. As a result, silver now costs ₹2,24,900 per kilogram, down ₹100 from the previous rate. 
 Gold rate today in Hyderabad
 The table below lists the updated indicative gold prices in Hyderabad on October 24, 2026. The 8-gram and 10-gram prices reflect the latest per-gram rates.

 Gold price in Hyderabad: Today vs yesterday
 Gold prices declined across all three purity categories compared with the previous rates. However, the drop remained limited to ₹1 per gram. 
 Gold purity Previous rate (10 grams) Updated rate (10 grams) Change 
 24-carat gold ₹1,42,480 ₹1,42,470 -₹10

 Therefore, buyers will pay ₹10 less per 10 grams than at the previously reported rates. The comparison uses the earlier figures and the latest prices provided for this update.
 Silver rate today in Hyderabad
 Silver prices in Hyderabad also edged lower on October 24. The rate fell by ₹0.10 per gram to ₹224.90. Consequently, the price of one kilogram dropped by ₹100 to ₹2,24,900.
 Silver quantity Updated price 
 1 gram ₹224.90 
 10 grams ₹2,249 
 100 grams ₹22,490 
 1 kilogram ₹2,24,900 
 Previous rate per kilogram ₹2,25,000 
 Daily change per kilogram -₹100 
 The prices for smaller quantities follow the updated per-gram rate. However, buyers should confirm the day’s rate with local jewellers before making a purchase.
 Why gold prices differ across websites and jewellery stores
 Gold-rate websites may show different prices because they update their figures at different times and use different market benchmarks. In addition, some websites publish indicative city rates, while others report benchmark prices or estimates.
 The India Bullion and Jewellers Association (IBJA) publishes benchmark rates for gold and silver. However, these benchmarks do not necessarily match the retail selling prices that Hyderabad jewellers quote on the same day.
 The final jewellery bill may also include GST, making charges and other applicable fees. According to the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC), the GST rate on jewellery is 3% of the total transaction value, including making charges where applicable.
 Hyderabad Mail has not independently verified prices at individual jewellery outlets. Therefore, buyers should confirm the gold rate, purity, making charges and applicable taxes with their chosen retailer before purchasing.
 What is the 22-carat gold rate today in Hyderabad?
 The 22-carat gold rate is ₹13,059 per gram, or ₹1,30,590 per 10 grams, on October 24, 2026.
 What is the 24-carat gold price today in Hyderabad?
 The 24-carat gold rate is ₹14,247 per gram, or ₹1,42,470 per 10 grams.
 What is the 18-carat gold rate today in Hyderabad?
 The 18-carat gold rate is ₹10,685 per gram, or ₹1,06,850 per 10 grams.
 What is the silver rate today in Hyderabad?
 Silver costs ₹224.90 per gram and ₹2,24,900 per kilogram, following a decline of ₹100 per kilogram.
 Gold and silver prices are based on the Goodreturns city rate table cited in this report. These figures are indicative and have not been independently verified at individual jewellery stores.
